{{ModBox}}
<section begin=intro />
'''Rising Storm''' is an {{WF|Ash}} [[Warframe Augment Mod]] that allows the attacks by clones generated by {{A|Blade Storm}} to give additional Combo points to the [[Melee 2.0#Combo Counter|Melee Combo Counter]], as well as increases the duration the Melee Combo Counter lasts.
<section end=intro />
== Stats ==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! {{Stat|Ability Strength|icon=only}}Bonus Combo per Attack
! Bonus Combo Duration
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 1 || 10s || 6
|-
| 1 || 2 || 10s || 7
|-
| 2 || 3 || 10s || 8
|-
| 3 || 4 || 10s || 9
|}

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be acquired by attaining the rank of '''Maxim''' under the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}, or the rank of '''Exalted''' under the {{Faction|Red Veil}}, and spending {{sc|25,000}} to purchase.

==Notes==
*Bonus hits are affected by both [[Ability Strength]] and melee combo count chance.
*The augment confers the extra ten second Melee Combo Counter duration regardless of its rank. This bonus duration is not affected by [[Ability Duration]] mods.
*Synergizes well with {{M|Drifting Contact}}, {{M|Body Count}}, and {{M|Gladiator Rush}} for a total combo counter duration of '''41''' seconds at max rank.
